finding.expected: Define one canonical envelope format and one canonical subject-identity location. Reject undocumented aliases and duplicate/conflicting identity representations rather than normalizing or silently selecting one representation. Preserve exactly the four allowlisted operations and the file/stdin carrier separation.
finding.issue: The ingress parser exposes more than one canonical envelope representation. It accepts both AIOS_INGRESS_ENVELOPE and AIOS_AUTHORING_INGRESS formats and also accepts subject identity both inside identity and as top-level task_id/run_id/source_run_id/finding_id/ failed_run_id fields. When the same identity key is supplied in both places with conflicting values, the nested identity silently wins instead of the envelope failing closed. TASK-104 requires one versioned semantic ingress envelope and deterministic, unambiguous subject identity.
